_note: Thresholds live here, not in code. Every rule must pass (AND). metric names: costUsdM, massMarginFrac (spare mass share, 0.2 = 80% of launcher capacity used), linkMarginDb, dataGb, survivedEvents, reliability (Monte Carlo success rate 0..1). requireSuccess: the run must have succeeded.
source: MissionForge team game design; thresholds are game goals, not real-mission figures.

achievements.name: First Contact
achievements.description: The link works and the mission succeeds.

achievements.name: Budget Master
achievements.description: Succeed with a total cost under 100 M USD.

achievements.name: Lightweight
achievements.description: Succeed using under 80% of the launcher capacity.

achievements.name: Science Machine
achievements.description: Get 300 GB or more of data to the ground.

achievements.name: Perfect Mission
achievements.description: All requirements met and reliability above 90%.
